notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content:
Eliminated unused textures to reduce game loading time.
Reworked graphics options and set defaults to perform faster on low end platforms.
Users can of course modify the graphics options to higher quality settings and resolution.

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.content:
JAM Entertainment Games is pleased to announce the availability of a demo for Path To The Devil and a new price of only $6.99.

So now you can try before you buy to see if this game is right for you.  

The demo allows you to play the game for 10 minutes each time you start a new game and of course you can play as many games as you like.  

Although this will give you a taste of the game it will be pretty basic as deck building games tend to get more interesting as you build a deck and face stronger enemies.

Have fun!
